storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. You can still practise, but progress and results will be lost when this tab closes or reloads.
storageFailed: Your latest changes could not be saved. You can continue in this tab, but changes will be lost on reload. Existing saved history has been kept.
invalidRecords: Some saved records could not be read and have been skipped. Other saved attempts are still available.
